name: import_svg_sketch
description: Create or reuse a PartDesign Body and Sketcher sketch from the client-attached SVG reference (context.extra.reference_image media_type image/svg+xml). Units are millimetres. No path argument: the client supplies the local SVG at Apply time. Fails closed when no SVG is attached or path/edge counts exceed caps.

name.description: Name for the new Sketcher sketch.

body_name.description: PartDesign Body to reuse, or to create with this name when it does not exist (keeps a plan's identifiers intact). Omit to create a new Body named <name>_Body.
